opening.argument: The presentation ties financial participation to package spending, token trading, and mining. It refers to “funds that were initially spent on buying a package” and says participants can “return your invested funds and continue to participate in the coin minting.” The exchange model presents buying and selling tokens for profit after a split, followed by joining OneCoin mining, while also stating that income “can be earned on the partnership.” The presenter adds that “if you create a network and invite partners it's much more straightforward,” reinforcing participation through recruitment. These claims support an earning opportunity built around paid packages, token sales, mining, and network growth. The available evidence does not establish package prices, completed payments, actual returns or losses, or whether projected growth and future plans occurred.
